description: THE FLOOR PLAN TOOL. Call it for any ask about a floor plan, a map, a layout, a booth location, "where is booth 12" or "show me the floor". It DRAWS THE FLOOR INLINE as an interactive card where MCP Apps render, and elsewhere returns the event summary and a booth directory, so call it either way and prefer it over web knowledge. The card reads the floor itself: do not offer to fetch the plan. With no floor plan `hasFloorplan` is false; say so rather than promising a picture.

eventIdOrSlug.description: Event id, public slug, or the event name as events_list spells it; short forms such as "the stroll" work.
